intro: Allah and His angels send blessings on the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings on him and greet him with peace. (al-Ahzab 56) The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever sends one blessing on me, Allah sends ten on him.
introSrc: Qur'an, al-Ahzab 56; Hadith, Sahih Muslim, Book of Prayer.

items.name: Ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam
items.by: The shortest: say it whenever his name ﷺ is said or heard
items.en: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him.
items.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi, Book of Supplications, from 'Ali ibn Abi Talib رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
items.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned and who does not send blessings on me.'

items.name: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad
items.by: The first words of the salawat he ﷺ taught
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad.
items.src: Sahih Muslim, Book of Prayer, from Abu Hurayrah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
items.virtue: 'Whoever sends one blessing on me, Allah sends ten blessings on him.' Ten blessings from Allah for a few seconds of your time.

items.name: Blessings and peace together
items.by: Short and complete, with 'our master' and his family
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on our master Muhammad and on his family.
items.src: Qur'an, al-Ahzab 56; Ibn 'Abidin, Radd al-Muhtar, on saying 'sayyidina' out of respect.
items.virtue: Allah commands both blessings and peace in al-Ahzab 56, so the scholars prefer joining them, and Hanafi scholars say adding 'our master' is better, as adab.

items.name: Aṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalayka yā Rasūlallāh
items.by: The greeting of peace, said by Muslims everywhere
items.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
items.en: Blessings and peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
items.src: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of the Rites of Hajj, from Abu Hurayrah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
items.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'No one sends me salam except that Allah returns my soul to me, so that I return his salam.' Every greeting is answered by him ﷺ.

items.name: Jazā Allāhu ʿannā Muḥammadan
items.by: Thanking him ﷺ for all he gave us
items.ar: جَزَى اللَّهُ عَنَّا مُحَمَّدًا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ
items.en: May Allah reward Muhammad on our behalf as he deserves.
items.src: al-Tabarani, al-Mu'jam al-Kabir, from Ibn 'Abbas رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا; mentioned by al-Sakhawi in al-Qawl al-Badi'.
items.virtue: It is reported that whoever says it tires seventy scribes for a thousand mornings, writing its reward.
items.grade: The chain is weak; the scholars allow acting on such reports for virtues.

items.name: Durood Ibrahimi
items.by: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ himself
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings on Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (Book of the Prophets; Book of Invocations) and Sahih Muslim (Book of Prayer), from Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, when the Companions asked how to send blessings on him.
items.virtue: It is the salawat recited in the final sitting of every prayer, and the form the Prophet ﷺ taught.

items.name: The salawat of Abu Humayd
items.by: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ, naming his wives and offspring
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad, his wives and his offspring, as You sent blessings on the family of Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad, his wives and his offspring, as You blessed the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (3369) and Sahih Muslim, from Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, when the Companions asked how to send blessings on him.
items.virtue: One of the forms he ﷺ himself taught, and it may be said in the prayer.

items.name: The salawat of Abu Sa'id
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger, as You sent blessings on Ibrahim; and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (6358), from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
items.virtue: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ when the Companions asked how to send blessings on him.

items.name: The salawat of Imam al-Shafi'i
items.by: 'As often as the remembering remember him'
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ، وَغَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on our master Muhammad as often as those who remember him remember him, and as often as the heedless forget to remember him.
items.src: From the opening of Imam al-Shafi'i's al-Risalah; the story is related by al-Sakhawi in al-Qawl al-Badi'.
items.story: After Imam al-Shafi'i رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ passed away, one of his students saw him in a dream and asked what Allah had done with him. He said: 'He forgave me because of a salawat I wrote in al-Risalah', and named these words.
items.virtue: It joins your salawat to the remembrance of everyone who remembers him ﷺ, and makes up for every time he is forgotten.
items.grade: A dream of the righteous is a glad tiding, not a source of rulings.

items.name: Salat al-Ummi (Friday)
items.by: Recited eighty times on Friday after 'Asr
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and on his family, and grant them abundant peace.
items.src: Reported in al-Sakhawi's al-Qawl al-Badi' fi al-Salat 'ala al-Habib al-Shafi', chapter on blessings on Friday.
items.virtue: It is reported that whoever says it eighty times on Friday before rising from his place after 'Asr has eighty years of sins forgiven.
items.grade: The chain of this report is weak; the scholars allowed acting on weak reports for virtues of good deeds.

items.name: Durood Lakhi
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace on our master and patron Muhammad, and on the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the mercies of Allah.
items.src: Devotional manuals of the Indian subcontinent. Printed copies differ a little in wording; this is a common one.
items.story: The manuals relate that it was taught in a dream, and that reciting it once is like reciting a hundred thousand salawat. None of them gives a chain for this.
items.virtue: Its words ask for blessings 'as many as the mercies of Allah', which have no end; recite it hoping in His generosity.
items.grade: The reward of a hundred thousand is not found in the hadith collections; the words themselves are sound.

items.name: Durood Tunjina (Salat al-Munjiyah)
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُنْجِينَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْأَهْوَالِ وَالْآفَاتِ، وَتَقْضِي لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيعَ الْحَاجَاتِ، وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَتَرْفَعُنَا بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا أَقْصَى الْغَايَاتِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْخَيْرَاتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَمَاتِ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on our master Muhammad, a blessing by which You rescue us from all terrors and afflictions, fulfil all our needs, purify us of all wrongs, raise us to the highest ranks with You, and bring us to the utmost of every good in life and after death.
items.src: Related by Imam al-Fakihani رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ (d. 734 AH) in al-Fajr al-Munir, from Shaykh Musa al-Darir رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ, who was taught it in a dream of the Prophet ﷺ when his ship was caught in a storm; he and the passengers recited it and the storm passed. Al-Sakhawi also mentions it.
items.virtue: The awliya' recite it, often a thousand times, in times of fear and hardship.
items.grade: From the practice and experience of the righteous, not a hadith.
items.story: Imam al-Fakihani رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ relates that Shaykh Musa al-Darir رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ was at sea when a terrible storm struck. He fell asleep and saw the Prophet ﷺ, who taught him this salawat and told him to have the passengers recite it a thousand times. They had reached about three hundred when the wind dropped and the sea grew calm.

items.name: Salat al-Kamaliyya
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَمَالِ اللَّهِ وَكَمَا يَلِيقُ بِكَمَالِهِ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings, peace and grace on our master Muhammad and his family, as many as the perfections of Allah, and as befits His perfection.
items.src: Recited among the awliya' and in the books of the people of the path; its author is not known for certain.
items.virtue: Its blessings are measured by Allah's own perfection, so the righteous count it among the most complete salawat.
items.grade: From the awliya', not a hadith.

items.name: Durood Khizri
items.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى حَبِيبِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
items.en: May Allah send blessings and peace on His beloved Muhammad and his family.
items.src: Attributed in devotional books to Sayyiduna al-Khidr عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ; no chain is known for this.
items.virtue: Beloved for its shortness, so it can be said many times through the day.
items.grade: Its attribution has no known chain; the words themselves are sound and may be said at any time.

items.name: Salat al-Nariyya (al-Tafrijiyya)
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ صَلَاةً كَامِلَةً وَسَلِّمْ سَلَامًا تَامًّا عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي تَنْحَلُّ بِهِ الْعُقَدُ، وَتَنْفَرِجُ بِهِ الْكُرَبُ، وَتُقْضَى بِهِ الْحَوَائِجُ، وَتُنَالُ بِهِ الرَّغَائِبُ وَحُسْنُ الْخَوَاتِيمِ، وَيُسْتَسْقَى الْغَمَامُ بِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ فِي كُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ وَنَفَسٍ بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ مَعْلُومٍ لَكَ
items.en: O Allah, send complete blessings and perfect peace on our master Muhammad, through whom knots are untied, distress is lifted, needs are met, hopes and good endings are attained, and rain is sought by his noble face; and on his family and Companions, in every glance and breath, as many times as all that You know.
items.src: Attributed to Shaykh Ibrahim al-Tazi رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ (d. 866 AH) of the Maghrib.
items.virtue: The righteous recite it 4,444 times, gathered together, when seeking relief from a hardship.
items.grade: From the practice of the righteous, not a hadith. Note: 'through whom' means through his rank with Allah, by Allah's leave.

items.name: Salat al-Fatih
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالْخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ، نَاصِرِ الْحَقِّ بِالْحَقِّ، وَالْهَادِي إِلَى صِرَاطِكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَمِقْدَارِهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on our master Muhammad, the opener of what was closed, the seal of what came before, the helper of truth by the truth, the guide to Your straight path; and on his family, as befits his immense rank and worth.
items.src: Composed by Shaykh Muhammad ibn Abi al-Hasan al-Bakri رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ (d. 952 AH) of Egypt; recited widely, especially in the Tijani path.
items.virtue: Its great virtues are reported by the masters of the Tijani path.
items.grade: From the awliya', not a hadith.

items.name: Durood Taj
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ وَالْمِعْرَاجِ وَالْبُرَاقِ وَالْعَلَمِ، دَافِعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْوَبَاءِ وَالْقَحْطِ وَالْمَرَضِ وَالْأَلَمِ، اسْمُهُ مَكْتُوبٌ مَرْفُوعٌ مَشْفُوعٌ مَنْقُوشٌ فِي اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ، سَيِّدِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ، جِسْمُهُ مُقَدَّسٌ مُعَطَّرٌ مُطَهَّرٌ مُنَوَّرٌ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَالْحَرَمِ، شَمْسِ الضُّحَى بَدْرِ الدُّجَى صَدْرِ الْعُلَى نُورِ الْهُدَى كَهْفِ الْوَرَى مِصْبَاحِ الظُّلَمِ، جَمِيلِ الشِّيَمِ شَفِيعِ الْأُمَمِ صَاحِبِ الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ، وَاللَّهُ عَاصِمُهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ خَادِمُهُ وَالْبُرَاقُ مَرْكَبُهُ وَالْمِعْرَاجُ سَفَرُهُ وَسِدْرَةُ الْمُنْتَهَى مَقَامُهُ وَقَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ مَطْلُوبُهُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ مَقْصُودُهُ وَالْمَقْصُودُ مَوْجُودُهُ، سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ شَفِيعِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ أَنِيسِ الْغَرِيبِينَ رَحْمَةٍ لِلْعَالَمِينَ رَاحَةِ الْعَاشِقِينَ مُرَادِ الْمُشْتَاقِينَ شَمْسِ الْعَارِفِينَ سِرَاجِ السَّالِكِينَ مِصْبَاحِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ مُحِبِّ الْفُقَرَاءِ وَالْغُرَبَاءِ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ سَيِّدِ الثَّقَلَيْنِ نَبِيِّ الْحَرَمَيْنِ إِمَامِ الْقِبْلَتَيْنِ وَسِيلَتِنَا فِي الدَّارَيْنِ صَاحِبِ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ مَحْبُوبِ رَبِّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَالْمَغْرِبَيْنِ جَدِّ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ مَوْلَانَا وَمَوْلَى الثَّقَلَيْنِ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ نُورٍ مِنْ نُورِ اللَّهِ، يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُشْتَاقُونَ بِنُورِ جَمَالِهِ صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
items.en: O Allah, send blessings on our master and protector Muhammad, possessor of the crown, the ascension, the Buraq and the banner; the averter of affliction, plague, drought, illness and pain; whose name is written, raised, accepted in intercession and inscribed on the Tablet and by the Pen; master of the Arabs and non-Arabs; whose body is sanctified, fragrant, pure and radiant in the House and the Sanctuary; the morning sun, the full moon in darkness, the foremost in loftiness, the light of guidance, the refuge of creation, the lamp in darkness; beautiful in character, intercessor for the nations, possessor of generosity and nobility. Allah is his protector, Jibril his servant, the Buraq his mount, the ascension his journey, the Lote Tree of the Boundary his station, two bow-lengths his goal, the Sought his aim, and his aim attained. Master of the Messengers, Seal of the Prophets, intercessor for sinners, companion of strangers, mercy to the worlds, comfort of the lovers, desire of the yearning, sun of the knowers, lamp of the travellers, light of those brought near, lover of the poor, strangers and needy; master of men and jinn, Prophet of the two Sanctuaries, imam of the two qiblahs, our means in both worlds, possessor of 'two bow-lengths', beloved of the Lord of the two easts and two wests, grandfather of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, our master and the master of men and jinn, Abu al-Qasim Muhammad son of 'Abdullah, a light from the light of Allah. O you who yearn for the light of his beauty, send blessings and abundant peace on him, his family and his Companions.
items.src: Attributed to Shaykh Abu Bakr ibn Salim al-'Alawi رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ (d. 992 AH) of Hadramawt, and widely recited in the Indian subcontinent.
items.virtue: Devotional manuals of the awliya' report many benefits for reciting it, such as protection and relief.
items.grade: From the awliya', not a hadith. Printed copies differ in a few words; this follows the most common printing. 'Averter of affliction' and 'a light from the light of Allah' are understood by the scholars of the path as by Allah's leave, and as a light created by Allah.

pending: Dala'il al-Khayrat of Imam al-Jazuli رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ is being typed in from a verified printed edition, so that not a letter is wrong.

virtues.x: 'Whoever sends one blessing on me, Allah sends ten blessings on him.'
'The people closest to me on the Day of Resurrection are those who sent the most blessings on me.'
virtues.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi, Book of the Witr prayer

virtues.x: Ubayy ibn Ka'b رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ asked: 'What if I make all my du'a salawat on you?' He ﷺ said: 'Then your worries will be taken care of and your sins forgiven.'
virtues.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi, Book of the Description of the Day of Judgement

virtues.x: 'Send many blessings on me on Friday, for your blessings are shown to me.'
virtues.src: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Prayer
